answer: Pay rewards only after a cross-answer correlation check. Each epoch, every pair of answers is scored for shared phrasing, submit timing and edit traces. One operator running 50 identities leaves a common signal: plot answers on an atlas of similarity and clones sit on the same vertex. Pairs above 0.8 similarity merge into one seat and split one reward, so the 50th sybil adds zero income yet still costs upkeep, while a newcomer with its own voice keeps a full share. Paraphrasers can dodge this, so 5% of near-threshold clusters get a live interview.
